tagline.en: Draw the arcana or drop some candy.
tagline.id: Tarik kartu arcana atau jatuhkan permen.

items.en: Tarot: three cards, their multipliers multiply. Low, Medium or High risk.
items.id: Tarot: tiga kartu, multiplier-nya dikalikan. Risiko Rendah, Sedang, atau Tinggi.

items.en: Sweet: tumbling candy slot. 8 of a kind anywhere wins, bombs multiply up to ×100.
items.id: Sweet: slot permen berjatuhan. 8 simbol sama di mana saja menang, bom mengalikan sampai ×100.

items.en: The sign-in page now counts the games correctly.
items.id: Halaman login sekarang menghitung jumlah game dengan benar.

items.en: Event rounds in global Crash: staff can set where a future round ends. These rounds are marked in the history.
items.id: Ronde event di Crash global: staf bisa mengatur di mana ronde berikutnya berhenti. Ronde ini ditandai di riwayat.
